confidenceKey.high: Merchant named with this code in a MileLion, Mainly Miles or Suitesmile article from 2025 to 2026, or an issuer or network list, with no contradicting source.
confidenceKey.medium: Merchant named in a weaker source (SingSaver, MoneySmart, Money Bees, community wiki or reports), or sources agree on the family but not the exact code, or a chain code that individual properties may not follow.
confidenceKey.low: Category-level inference, a single community report, or sources that conflict. Verify on the first charge with the bank app or the Visa Supplier Locator.

matching: names are upper case descriptor fragments matched as whole words. exactNames are descriptors too generic to match inside longer text and should only match a whole descriptor. Where two records could match (for example ALP* for Alipay and ALP*DIDI), prefer the longest name. mcc.v null means no merchant-specific data point: use categoryDefaults. mccAlt lists other codes seen for the merchant. notAccepted lists card networks only, each with a source in notAcceptedS.

dining.note: Restaurants. Cafes are often 5814 and hotel restaurants may take the hotel code.

fast_food.note: Fast food chains, many cafes and bakeries.

groceries.note: Convenience stores are 5499; use the merchant record where known.

supermarket.note: All major Singapore supermarkets. Online and marketplace grocers can differ (5262, 5311 via HeyMax).

department_store.note: Department stores. Food fairs can code 5814.

clothing.note: Family clothing stores are 5651; this is the more common apparel code in MoneySmart's list.

electronics.note: Electronics stores; appliance stores can be 5722.

online_shopping.note: Marketplaces use many codes (5262, 5311, 5399, 5999). Check the merchant record.

transport.note: Local commuter transport. Taxis and ride-hailing are 4121.

airline.note: Most airlines carry their own code in 3000-3350; this generic code is inside the same bonus categories.

hotel.note: Chain hotels often use 3501-3999 instead; Maybank XL counts only 7011.

travel_agency.note: Online travel agencies are base only on several cards.

entertainment.note: Best guess for recreation and attractions (recreation services NEC). Cinemas are 7832 and attractions are sometimes 7991. No Singapore data point.

events_tickets.note: Ticket agencies; sports and venue ticketing can also code 7941 or 7999. No Singapore data point.

beauty.note: Beauty and barber shops; cosmetics retailers can be 5977.

medical.note: Health practitioners NEC. Hospitals (8062) and clinics (8011) differ and are often excluded or capped as bill payments.

insurance.note: Insurers use 5960 or 6300; zero or base only on most cards.

utilities.note: Zero earn on most stack cards.

telco.note: Telco bills. Often excluded or routed through AXS.

education.note: Schools and educational services NEC; 8211, 8220 and others also used. Zero earn on most cards.

government.note: Government services NEC; taxes are 9311. Zero earn on most cards.

charity.note: Charitable and social service organisations. Zero earn on most cards.

fitness.note: Clubs and memberships; gyms can also code 7941 or 7991.

other.note: No default. Set a category or override the MCC.
